element.description: Current matrix element $\lvert\langle S\vert\partial_\phi H\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$

linear_splitting.description: Linear law $A\lvert\langle S\vert\partial_\phi H\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$ at $A=0.4$

strong_linear_ratio.description: Sambe splitting at $A=1$ over the linear law

strong_rwa_ratio.description: RWA splitting at $A=1$ over the linear law, $8J_1(1/4)$

symmetric_element.description: Current matrix element at $\epsilon=0$ (eta selection rule)

symmetric_charge_element.description: Charge matrix element $\lvert\langle S\vert n_d\vert S^*\rangle\rvert$ at $\epsilon=0$

symmetric_mixing.description: Largest weight of $S^*$ in the dressed $S$, or of $S$ in the dressed $S^*$, at $\epsilon=0$

symmetric_crossing.description: Frequency at which the replicas cross at $\epsilon=0$, $A=0.4$

fan_omega0.description: Pair transition energy with two bath level pairs per lead

dressed_shift.description: Dressed-singlet shift $\varepsilon_S-E_S$ at $A=1$, $\Omega=0.6$ (two bath level pairs)

averaged_shift.description: Shift of $E_S$ in the time-averaged $H_0$ at $A=1$

averaged_check.description: Difference of $E_S$ between $H_0$ and the junction with $\Gamma J_0(A/4)^2$

ac_stark_shift.description: AC Stark part of the dressed-singlet shift at $A=1$

fan_crossing.description: Amplitude of the first avoided crossing of the dressed singlet at $\Omega=0.6$
